saw_lines: Spice buyers try a blend once, keep the ones that work, and reorder them on a schedule.
So the sale is won in the first line, where the offer and the reorder reason must appear.
Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 26 ads mention it. Put that offer in the opening line of three new ads, printing up to 10% on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 26 ads mention it. New buyers see no reason to act. Put that offer in the opening line of three new ads, printing up to 10% on the creative.

Your site lists free shipping for the lower 48 states, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. First time buyers hold off when delivery is unclear. Open three new ads with the free shipping line.

Your site runs subscribe and save at 10% each time you restock, yet 0 of 30 ads mention a subscription. Repeat buyers never hear about it. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline.

Your site explains how orders arrive, yet 0 of 30 ads mention delivery. A buyer ordering spices online wants to know the box arrives intact. Shoot one video of the box on a doorstep, answering it in three seconds.
